top_signals.title: Anthropic Investor Slams VC’s AI Miss | Open Interest 8/21/2026
top_signals.summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." AI spending hits overdrive as Broadcom eyes a massive $60 billion debt deal ahead of Nvidia earnings. Anthropic sets its sights on a potentially record-breaking IPO. Early Anthropic investor Anjney Midha unloads on traditional venture capital, arguing firms failed investors by missing the AI revolution. Plus, Critical Metals CEO Tony Sage says his company's key Greenland mining project is on track. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: China's Traders Find Meaning in Niu Lai
top_signals.summary: A crude animated film has become a meme for Chinese retail investors who see their own market struggles in its characters. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Shuli Ren explains why Niu Lai has struck a nerve. (Source: Bloomberg)
